parameters.name: level
parameters.explanation: 维护域的级别，用于区分不同层次的维护域。

set protocols cfm maintenance-domain md1.template: set protocols cfm maintenance-domain [parameter1] level-[parameter2] maintenance-association [parameter3]
set protocols cfm maintenance-domain md1.command: set protocols cfm maintenance-domain md1 level-2 maintenance-association ma1
set protocols cfm maintenance-domain md1.explanation: 在指定的维护域和级别下配置维护关联。

set protocols cfm maintenance-domain md1.template: set protocols cfm maintenance-domain [parameter1] level-[parameter2] maintenance-association [parameter3] map-name [parameter4]
set protocols cfm maintenance-domain md1.command: set protocols cfm maintenance-domain md1 level-2 maintenance-association ma1 map-name "mpls-l2vc-1001-tagged"
set protocols cfm maintenance-domain md1.explanation: 为维护关联配置映射名称。

parameters.name: map-name
parameters.explanation: 映射名称，用于标识特定的维护关联。

set protocols cfm maintenance-domain md1.template: set protocols cfm maintenance-domain [parameter1] level-[parameter2] maintenance-association [parameter3] mep [parameter4] interface [parameter5] direction [parameter6]
set protocols cfm maintenance-domain md1.command: set protocols cfm maintenance-domain md1 level-2 maintenance-association ma1 mep 2 interface ge-1/0/1.1 direction inward
set protocols cfm maintenance-domain md1.explanation: 配置维护端点（MEP）的接口和方向。

set protocols cfm maintenance-domain md1.template: set protocols cfm maintenance-domain [parameter1] level-[parameter2] maintenance-association [parameter3] mep [parameter4] ccm-transmit
set protocols cfm maintenance-domain md1.command: set protocols cfm maintenance-domain md1 level-2 maintenance-association ma1 mep 2 ccm-transmit
set protocols cfm maintenance-domain md1.explanation: 配置维护端点（MEP）发送CCM（Continuity Check Message）消息。

set protocols cfm maintenance-domain md1.template: set protocols cfm maintenance-domain [parameter1] level-[parameter2] maintenance-association [parameter3] mep [parameter4] remote-mep [parameter5]
set protocols cfm maintenance-domain md1.command: set protocols cfm maintenance-domain md1 level-2 maintenance-association ma1 mep 2 remote-mep 1
set protocols cfm maintenance-domain md1.explanation: 配置维护端点（MEP）的远程维护端点（RMEP）。

parameters.name: remote-mep
parameters.explanation: 远程维护端点的标识符。

set protocols cfm maintenance-domain md1.template: set protocols cfm maintenance-domain [parameter1] level-[parameter2] maintenance-association [parameter3] remote-mep [parameter4] ccm-receive

parameters.explanation: 远程维护端点的标识符。

set protocols cfm maintenance-domain md1.template: set protocols cfm maintenance-domain [parameter1] level-[parameter2] maintenance-association [parameter3] test [parameter4] mep [parameter5] remote-mep [parameter6] loss-measure single-ended continual-send interval [parameter7]

set protocols cfm maintenance-domain md1.explanation: 配置单端丢失测量测试的持续发送参数和间隔。
